fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami as a "playground" and concerns about moral intolerance; criticism of A&P chain-store practices and calls to support local grocers; discussion of real estate prices and promotion of low-priced lots; commentary on nightclubs and minimum charges; concerns about Jackson Memorial Hospital budget cuts and use of an efficiency expert; notes on traffic, parking, sidewalks, and the need for an airport; political notes on local judicial and county races; a satirical feature "The Gods of Miami" by Don Moore; assorted local gossip/briefs and extensive local business advertising, including Burdine's holiday shopping promotion and an update on a Marion County, Florida oil drilling test.
